grammar.title: 表示推测的情态助动词 must be 与 can't be
grammar.structure: must be + 表语（肯定推测）/ can't be + 表语（否定推测）
grammar.definition: must be 表示最有力的肯定推断「一定是」；否定推断用 can't be「不可能是」，不用 mustn't（mustn't 表禁止）。推测正在进行的动作用 must be doing。
grammar.usage: It must be Karen Marsh, the actress. / It can't be. / She must be at least forty.

examples.en: He can't be a doctor. He must be a dentist.
examples.zh: 他不会是医生。他一定是牙医。

examples.en: He can't be shaving. He must be having a bath.
examples.zh: 他不可能在剃胡子，他一定是在洗澡。

grammar.title: 反意疑问句与否定疑问感叹
grammar.structure: 肯定陈述 + 否定附加问（... , wasn't it?）/ 否定疑问句表感叹（Doesn't he look old!）
grammar.definition: 附加疑问句遵循「前肯后否、前否后肯」；用否定疑问句式可表达惊讶或感叹（Doesn't Karen Marsh look old!）。回答按事实决定肯定或否定，不受问句形式影响。
grammar.usage: Isn't he her third husband? / She does, doesn't she! / That was a long time ago, wasn't it?

examples.en: Doesn't Karen Marsh look old!
examples.zh: 卡伦·马什看上去多显老啊！

examples.en: That was a long time ago, wasn't it?
examples.zh: 那是好久以前的事了，是吗？

grammar.title: so 作代词与 not more than
grammar.structure: think / hope / expect + so / not more than + 数词
grammar.definition: so 作代词意为「这样」，I think so 的否定式是 I don't think so；not more than 意为「不超过、不到」，反身代词 myself 可作同位语加强语气。

questions.q: Why do we say 'She can't be Italian' instead of 'She mustn't be Italian'?
questions.zh: 为什么说 She can't be Italian 而不说 She mustn't be Italian？
questions.a: can't be expresses a strong negative deduction ('impossible'), while mustn't expresses prohibition ('must not / be not allowed'). For negative guesses we use can't be.
questions.aZh: can't be 表示强有力的否定推断「不可能是」，mustn't 表示「禁止、不许」；否定推测只能用 can't be。
questions.hint: 推测的否定形式是 can't，不是 mustn't。

questions.q: I don't think so. She can't be Italian. She must be Greek. / He can't be a mechanic. He must be an engineer.
questions.zh: 第 128 课操练：can't be（不可能是）+ must be（一定是）的对照推断。
questions.a: I don't think so. They can't be Canadian. They must be Australian. / I don't think so. It can't be cheap. It must be expensive.

title: A famous actress / must be 与 can't be
subtitle: 著名的女演员 / 推测：一定是与不可能是

lead.question: 远远看见一个明星，怎么用英语表达「那一定是她」「不可能是他」？先猜猜：报上说 29 岁、看起来至少 40 岁的女演员，到底多少岁？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你和朋友在街上认明星：「那一定是女演员卡伦·马什！」「不可能是她旁边的男演员！让我再看看。」英文里最有力的推测用 must be（一定是）和 can't be（不可能是），注意否定推断不用 mustn't。另外本课还有一大串反意疑问句：Isn't he her third husband? Doesn't Karen Marsh look old! 先试着说「她一定至少 40 岁」，再听凯特和米莉的八卦闲聊。
goals: 掌握 must be 表示最有力的肯定推测
掌握 can't be 表示否定推测（不可能是），不与 mustn't 混淆
掌握反意疑问句：Isn't he ...? / She does, doesn't she! / ... , wasn't it?
认识 famous / actress / actor / at least / not more than 等表达
lead.summary: 第 127 课：凯特问米莉能否认出那个女人——一定是女演员卡伦·马什；她旁边的一定是演员康拉德·里弗斯。凯特惊叹卡伦显老：报上说 29 岁，但肯定至少 40 了。米莉调侃道：自己读书时她就是名演员了，可那也没多久——我自己还不到 29 岁呢。全课核心是 must be / can't be 表推测。第 128 课用 She can't be Italian. She must be Greek. 等几十组句型反复操练。
lead.tips: ① 肯定推断用 must be，否定推断用 can't be，绝不用 mustn't；② must/can't 表推测时常与 be 连用：He must be a dentist. / She can't be Danish.；③ 推测进行中的动作用 must be doing：He must be having a bath.；④ 反意疑问句：前否后肯（Isn't he her third husband?），回答按事实；She does, doesn't she! 是感叹式的反意；⑤ at least 至少；not more than 不超过、不到；⑥ I thought so. 我也这样想（so 作代词）；have another look 再看一眼。
